intro.narration: [excited] Heey, ninety-two times eleven. In your head, before the calculator app even opens.

steps.narration: [curious] Looks tricky. There's a two-step shortcut.
[confident] Split the digits — nine and two. [pause] Add them: nine plus two is eleven.
[thoughtful] Eleven has two digits — you can't just drop it between. [pause] So carry the one over.
[excited] Nine plus one is ten. [warm] The answer? One thousand and twelve.

outro.narration: [warm] Save this one, and try it on your own number.
outro.display: Save this. Try it on yours.
